purpose: Create a prospectively sampled, context-separated evaluation that can test frozen detector and verifier families without reusing the current exploratory selection process.

current_result_boundary.policy: Current values are historical context only and cannot be relabeled as Confirmation Set v1 results.

dataset_strategy.recommended_sequence: The source audit and context-manifest gates are complete. A private, Git-ignored manifest now fixes 48 unique complete-week contexts and the 6/15/27 split under a public SHA-256 commitment. Next define and validate deterministic question templates, scope-entity selection rules, gold calculations, and question-level evidence payload fingerprints without running the model. A separately scoped second-dataset replication remains required for stronger comparative or generalization claims.

options.source: UCI Online Retail cleaned lineage already used by BizHallu
advantages: keeps the existing business and accounting definitions
allows context-grouped sampling before any new model output is viewed
limitations: same underlying dataset as the exploratory study
reuses the same transaction population even when question families are new
cannot support cross-dataset or unseen-domain generalization

options.source: UCI Online Retail II restricted to 2009-12-01 inclusive through 2010-12-01 exclusive
advantages: preserves the current schema and accounting definitions
moves the study to unseen transaction rows and earlier business periods
supports a strict cutoff before the current Online Retail source begins
limitations: same retailer and source lineage as the exploratory study
the full workbook overlaps the current source, so the strict prior-period cutoff and frozen record-level fingerprint proof must remain in force
the verified capacity is limited to three source-feasible families; customer concentration remains blocked by missing Customer ID coverage

options.source: Complete Journey is the preferred external shortlist candidate, subject to acquisition, license-lineage, completeness, and metric-definition review
advantages: tests whether findings transfer beyond one retail table
limitations: requires a new source audit and cleaning pipeline
metric definitions may not map exactly to Online Retail

options.source: A future JHU course, capstone, operations, or healthcare dataset with permitted use
advantages: strong alignment with program coursework and faculty outreach
tests the business-fact grounding framework outside retail
limitations: availability and permissions are not yet known
should not delay the near-term internal replication

source_acceptance_criteria: row-level evidence supports deterministic gold calculations
time, entity, quantity, and value fields are documented
source completeness and duplicate handling can be audited
license or terms permit the intended local research use
no sensitive personal data is required for the public artifact
at least 48 disjoint evidence contexts can be formed without outcome-based filtering

protocol_pilot.purpose: Validate evidence schemas, prompts, claim boundaries, annotation instructions, and runtime only.

development.purpose: Freeze detector thresholds, verifier rules, extraction settings, and any hybrid combination.

confirmation.purpose: One sealed estimation-focused evaluation after all analytical decisions are frozen; no detector-superiority claim is authorized.

sampling_plan.selection_timing: All context and question identifiers are fixed before model generation.
sampling_plan.class_balance_policy: Do not force equal correct and hallucinated counts and do not drop answers based on correctness. Report natural prevalence.
sampling_plan.technical_failure_policy: Use a predefined retry rule for empty or interrupted generations; retain and report every selected question rather than replacing difficult outputs.

precision_review.review_method: Use outcome-blind prevalence and cluster-size scenarios to examine expected AUPRC uncertainty and paired-comparison precision. Do not use confirmation labels or detector outcomes.
precision_review.strong_comparison_result: No candidate from 15, 21, 24, or 27 confirmation contexts passed every frozen strong-comparison criterion.
precision_review.decision_policy: Increase the confirmation plan to the capacity-feasible balanced maximum of 27 contexts and narrow the primary objective to interval estimation. Report paired detector differences descriptively and never reduce or replace contexts after answer quality is observed.
precision_review.claim_limit: Confirmation Set v1 does not preregister a detector-superiority claim. Stronger comparison claims require additional independent contexts.

context_split_policy.implemented_algorithm: deterministic_hash_ordered_bipartite_augmenting_path_v1 followed by independent seeded within-family split ordering

candidate_families.business_value: accounting reconciliation of gross positive revenue, cancellations, and net revenue

candidate_families.reason: The source audit records 100207 missing Customer IDs. This family is excluded from the 48-context capacity target rather than introducing a complete-case denominator after inspecting capacity.

candidate_families.business_value: market and product concentration across business entities

requirements: gold answers are produced by deterministic structured calculations
evidence rows are not sorted into answer order unless the condition explicitly tests sorted evidence
metric definitions and exclusions are included in every prompt
question templates are frozen before protocol-pilot generation
pilot questions are never promoted into confirmation metrics

model_and_prompt_freeze.model_role: same-model replication unless a separately labeled model-transfer arm is preregistered
model_and_prompt_freeze.decode_policy: freeze model revision, tokenizer revision, prompt template, seed, decoding parameters, and max-new-token limit before the protocol pilot
model_and_prompt_freeze.multiple_generation_policy: If Semantic Entropy is included, freeze sample count, temperature, seed list, and semantic clustering implementation before confirmation access.

annotation_protocol.assistant_role: prepare packets, validate offsets, and support adjudication documentation; do not count as an independent human reviewer
blinding: reviewers do not see detector scores
reviewers do not see each other's labels
confirmation labels remain sealed until predictions and analysis code are frozen
annotation_protocol.claim_inventory_policy: Annotate every in-scope business-fact claim in every selected answer; do not use a high-priority or error-enriched span subset.
agreement_reporting: Cohen's kappa for supported versus contradicted-or-unmatched labels before adjudication
exact and overlap span F1 between reviewers before adjudication
annotation_protocol.adjudication: A documented third pass resolves disagreements without access to detector outcomes.
annotation_protocol.annotation_sample_selection: Question and response inventory is fixed before correctness review.

oracle_span_diagnostics.purpose: Compare frozen detector families on adjudicated business-fact spans.
oracle_span_diagnostics.claim_limit: Diagnostic span scoring only; not end-to-end detection.

claim_extraction.purpose: Evaluate automatic identification of business-fact claim spans.
metrics: exact span precision, recall, and F1
overlap span precision, recall, and F1

evidence_verification.purpose: Make independent supported, contradicted, unmatched, or needs-review decisions from generated claims and source evidence.
evidence_verification.constraint: Predictions cannot be copied or deterministically mapped from gold or presentation labels.
required_outputs: continuous unsupported-risk score on a frozen scale for AUPRC comparison
matched evidence reference or explicit no-match reason

end_to_end_audit.purpose: Combine automatic claim extraction with evidence verification and report abstentions and missed claims.

detector_comparison.primary_internal_candidate_basis: chosen from the current exploratory study and requiring fresh confirmation
detector_comparison.energy_family_role: report frozen prespecified energy signals without selecting a winner on confirmation
detector_comparison.literature_inclusion_gate: Decide feasibility and freeze included implementations before protocol-pilot generation.
detector_comparison.evidence_aware_family: independent claim-evidence consistency rules or model decisions developed only on pilot and development data
detector_comparison.hybrid_family: optional prespecified combination of internal and evidence-aware scores frozen on development
detector_comparison.confirmation_policy: Every frozen family is reported; no family is omitted because its confirmation result is weak, and no family is declared statistically superior in Confirmation Set v1.

metric_policy.primary_unit: adjudicated business-fact span for oracle-span diagnostics
secondary_metrics: coverage and abstention rate for evidence verification
metric_policy.uncertainty_interval: context-level BCa bootstrap when defined, with paired percentile context bootstrap as sensitivity
metric_policy.cluster_count_policy: The outcome-blind precision review increased sealed confirmation from 15 to 27 contexts. This remains below 30 independent clusters, so intervals require caution and subgroup slices remain descriptive.
metric_policy.per_group_reporting: Report question-family and fact-type slices with counts; label underpowered slices as descriptive.
metric_policy.multiple_comparison_policy: Primary reporting estimates each frozen detector family's AUPRC with uncertainty. Paired detector differences, additional detectors, and subgroup comparisons are descriptive or exploratory and do not support a superiority claim.
metric_policy.test_access_policy: Do not inspect confirmation labels, tune thresholds, select families, modify prompts, or revise verifier rules after confirmation evaluation begins.

execution_gates.progress: official workbook acquired and hashed; structure, strict-window completeness, duplicate/grain controls, cancellation/value rules, all 12 months, zero canonical plus date-blind historical record overlap, outcome-blind precision review, and capacity for 48 unique complete-week contexts verified
execution_gates.completion_evidence: Three allowed families each have 50 eligible observed complete weeks for 16 required slots; generalized Hall capacity has minimum slack 2 and independent maximum matching fills 48 of 48 slots.

claim_policy.before_execution: Confirmation Set v1 is a prospective design, not a completed experiment.
claim_policy.after_internal_replication: Claims remain limited to the selected model, dataset lineage, question families, and context split.
claim_policy.after_external_replication: Cross-dataset claims require a separately validated second-dataset result.
prohibited: publication-grade benchmark before independent labels and sealed evaluation
